newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV pays 89 pta final div, cuts nominal.
newsitem.headline: BBV pays 89 pta final div, cuts nominal.

text.p: The board of Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya agreed on Thursday to reduce its nominal share value by 25 pesetas and to make a final dividend payment of 89 pesetas compared with 72 in 1995, chairman Emilio de Ybarra said.
This brings the gross dividend payout for 1996 to 230 pesetas gross compared with 198.
Ybarra said that with the reduction in the nominal, the effective dividend to the shareholder will be 255 pesetas gross.
With this change, the nominal value of the shares is now 550 pesetas.
